rows.output: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọ pé òun kò ní dìbò nínú ìdìbò náà, àti pé ìpolongo ìkọ̀sílẹ̀ ti dà bí ẹni pé ìdìbò tó kéré jù lọ yóò pàdé àkókò tó kéré jù lọ fún ìdìbò náà láti jẹ́wọ́.
rows.reference: Ààrẹ Gjorge Ivanov ti sọpé òun kòní dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ àtipé ìpolongo fún ìdẹ́yẹsí kan ti jẹ́kí àwọn ìsiyèméjì wà lórí bóyá ìjádedìbò yóò tó ìdá àádọ́ta ninu ọgọ́ọ̀rún eyiti i ṣe iye tó kéré jùlọ tí wọ́n nílò fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà láti jẹ́ eyiti ó wúlò.

rows.output: Ìbéèrè tí wọ́n kọ sí káràkátà ìdìbò náà ni: "Ṣé o fẹ́ NATO àti ìbáṣepọ̀ EU pẹ̀lú ìfọwọ́sí àdéhùn pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì."
rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.output: Àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn ìyípadà orúkọ, títí kan Aláṣẹ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, ń sọ pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó tọ́ láti san láti lè tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ sí àwọn ara ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù bíi EU àti NATO fún Masedóníà, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jáde láti inú ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.output: "Mo wá lónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masedóníà kí wọ́n lè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ ààbò Ìparapọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-Èdè Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé ààbò fún gbogbo wa," ni Olivera Georgijevska, 79, ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò ní ìdánilójú ní òfin, àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó pọ̀ jù lọ ti sọ pé wọ́n máa bọ̀wọ̀ fún àbájáde ìdìbò náà, èyí tó mú kí ó ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì nínú mẹ́ta nínú ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìròyìn ìdàrúdàpọ̀ ní 1 ìrọ̀lẹ́.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn tó dìbò, ó wà ní 16 ogorun, ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú 34 ogorun ní ìdìbò àpéjọpọ̀ tó kẹ́yìn ní 2016 nígbà tí 66 ogorun àwọn tó wà nínú ìwé àdéhùn náà dìbò.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: "Mo jáde láti dìbò nítorí àwọn ọmọ mi, ibi wa ní Yúróòpù," Gjose Tanevski, 62, olùdìbò ní olú ìlú, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Wales sun damu da "yin kama da muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs game da shawarar canza sunansu zuwa MWPs (Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Wales).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a fadin faɗin siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya jawo dariya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce rukunin sa na da damuwa "yana daidai da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kai.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Plaid AM ya ce rukunin bai ji dadin hakan ba kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyi.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce jam'iyyarsa tana "bude tunani" game da canjin suna, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tafiya daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u a cikin Ingilishi na Yorkshire.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana aiki kan dokar gabatar da canje-canjen suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira 'yan majalisar zai dogara ne ga mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba Majalisar Wales damar canza sunanta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani bincike na jama'a kan shawarwarin da ta samu goyon baya mai fadi na kiran taron majalisar dokoki a matsayin Majalisar Dokokin Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a cikin tattaunawa ta jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna nuna cewa suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma gwagwarmayar cimma yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kudirin dokar canje-canje cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyaran da za ta hada da sauran sauye-sauye a yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da dokoki kan dakatar da mambobin da kuma tsarin tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su yi kuri'a ta karshe kan yadda za a kira su lokacin da suke tattaunawa kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Makidoniya ta tafi zabe a kan kiran kasar da sunan da za a canza
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa "Jamhuriyar Makedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne a kokarin warware rikicin da ya dade da makwabtaka da kasar Girka, wadda ke da yankinta mai suna Masedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi tsayin daka cewa sunan makwabtanta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirarin mallakar ƙasar ta, kuma ta ci gaba da adawa da neman shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Masedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya koma kan yin zaben, ya ce zai yi watsi da kuri'ar.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben, ciki har da Firaministan Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Karan Cocin St. Martin sun yi shiru yayin da Cocin a Harlem ke fafutuka
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane kusurwa," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya abu ne mai ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta wata hanya" ina cewa.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An daina kallon gidajen giya a matsayin dakunan taro na unguwa inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kuɗin da aka samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dade kamar yadda shugabanni suka yi tsammani ba, "kuma ba da jimawa ba za su koma inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci-coci, ya kara, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-ginen gidaje da gidajen da aka cika da mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran majami’u na unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da suke siyan gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance fari," ya ce, "kuma hakan zai sa waɗannan majami'u su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba zai yuwu mutanen da suka koma waɗannan gidajen haya su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u ba."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne ta hanyar taron jama'a kafin Harlem ya zama birnin bakar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Methodist ta asali ta fice a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar bakar fata da suke ibada a kusa da su sun dauki ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki St. Martin's a karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin da ya shafi masu sayar da kayayyaki a kan titin 125, babbar titin sayayya a Harlem, wadanda suka ki daukar ko inganta bakar fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wani wuta a shekarar 1939 ya lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da mabiya Father Johnson suka fara shirin sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Malam David Johnson, ɗan Mahaifin Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da kiran ƙararrawa "agogo na talakawa."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Ɗalibin da ya buga ƙararrawa a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu dabam: "Kasadar al'adu" da "wani kayan tarihi mara maye."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwararren ƙwarar
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce cewa St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: A cikin watanni da suka gabata, labarin St. Martin ya kasance labari mai rikitarwa na masu zanen gine-gine da masu gini, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar cocin - jikin masu gudanarwa da ba su da addini, wanda ya kunshi shugabannin al'umma - ya rubuta wa diocese a watan Yuli da damuwa cewa diocese "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsa waɗannan kuɗaɗen" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masu zanen gado da masu gini da diocese ta aika.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu mambobin cocin sun yi korafi game da rashin gaskiya dangane da yadda cocin ke tafiyar da harkokinsu.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifi ya raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don kama kifi a California
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: A matsayin wani babban yunkuri na shiga kasuwar kyau ta Burtaniya ta £2.8bn, wadda ke ci gaba da karuwa yayin da sayar da kayan kwalliya da kayan gida ke raguwa, manyan sassan kyau za a gwada su a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin kasar, kuma a kai su wasu shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyau ya zo ne yayin da manyan shagunan ke neman hanyoyin da za su yi amfani da sararin da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talabijin, microwave, da kayan daki.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyarsa zuwa kayayyaki 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.

rows.output: Kasuwancin da ake da su daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees ma za su samu karin sarari tare da wuraren da aka sanya sunayensu irin na wadanda ake samu a shagunan kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayayyaki na kuma sake kaddamar da layin kayan shafawa na Boutique don haka mafi yawan kayayyakin suna da dacewa da masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake bukata sosai da matasa masu siyayya.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da ƙamshi, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shaguna a cikin shagunan Sainsbury guda biyu, na farko da aka buɗe a Croydon, kudu maso London, a makon da ya gabata, yayin da na biyu ya buɗe a Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya a wannan shekara.

rows.output: Sayar da kaya ta yanar gizo da kuma sauyin zuwa siyan kadan na abinci a kullum a shagunan da ke kusa da su yana nufin cewa masu sayar da kayayyaki suna buƙatar yin ƙarin ƙoƙari don su sa mutane su ziyarci.

rows.output: Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sashe yayin da kungiyar ta na kokarin yin fafutuka da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da karin ayyuka da kayayyaki marasa abinci.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancin asibitinta na shago 281 ga Celesio, mai mallakar Lloyds Pharmacy, kan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.

rows.output: Yayin da Save the Children ke hada tawaga don tafiya zuwa Palu, har yanzu ba a tabbatar da ko ma'aikatan kasashen waje za su iya aiki a kasa ba.

rows.output: Duk da girgizar ƙasa da Indonesia ke fuskanta akai-akai, ƙasar na cikin haɗarin da ba a shirya ba ga fushin halitta.

rows.output: Jami'an tsaro sun bukaci mutanen yankin da suka ga ko suka ji wani abu da ya shafi lamarin su fito.

rows.output: Haka kuma zan roƙi kowa, musamman direbobin tasi, idan suna da wani abu da suka kama a cikin dashcam ɗin su, da su tuntuɓi mu saboda wannan bayanin na iya zama mai matuƙar amfani ga bincikenmu.

rows.output: Yahaya Goldsmith, shugaban kungiyar Cromwell Society, ya ce: "Ba abin da ya dace ba ne a cikin tattaunawar da ake yi a yanzu game da cire hotuna cewa siffar Oliver Cromwell a wajen fadar Westminster za ta zama abin da za a yi.

rows.output: An yi wa al'adun gargajiya na yakin basasa na Ingila ba tare da umarnin Cromwell ba, kuma ba a yi shi ba.

rows.output: Wani babban zane na Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft na Cromwell shaida ne na ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihi na wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin har yanzu ya cancanci murnar.
rows.reference: Akwai babbar bayani game da Cromwell na Sa William Hamo Thorneycroft da ke zama hujjar ra’ayi na karni na 19 wanda kuma ɓangare na ilimin bayanan tarihin na wani sananne wanda mafi yawa suka yi imani har yanzu ya kamata a yi murna a kansa.

rows.output: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin shi da yawa, watakila fiye da ƙarshen ƙarni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsin lamba daga waje, a cikinsa ba shakka sarauta.
rows.reference: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa a jaridar The Sunday Telegraph: “Mutane da yawa suna ɗaukan Cromwell, watakila sosai a shekarun karshe na karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin rikicin ba makawa da mulkin sarauta.

rows.output: Duk da haka, wannan yana nufin cewa akwai wani ra'ayi na tarihi da ake ci gaba da tattaunawa a kai.

rows.output: Abin da ya tabbata shi ne cewa rikicin na tsakiyar karni na 17 ya tsara ci gaban da ya biyo baya na kasarmu, kuma Cromwell mutum ne mai iya ganewa wanda ke wakiltar daya daga cikin bangarorin da suka raba.
rows.reference: Abin da ke da tabbaci shi ne rikicin na tsakiyar ƙarni na 17 ya gyara ci gaba na ƙasarmu da aka samu daga baya, kuma Cromwell wani mutum ne sananne da aka sani wanda ke wakiltar sashe ɗaya na wancan rikicin.

rows.output: Gwamnatinsa a matsayin Mai Karewa ya kuma cancanci a yi murna da kuma tunawa da shi."

rows.output: Zabin Flakes yana da karfi, saboda ya bayyana cewa 'yan Republican ba za su sami kuri'u don amincewa da Kavanaugh ba tare da binciken ba.
rows.reference: Zabin Flake yana da ƙarfi, saboda a bayyane yake ‘yan jam’iyyar Republican ba za su sami kuri’u don yarda da Kavanaugh ba tare da bincike ba.

rows.output: Shugaban Trump ya bude binciken FBI kan zargin da ake yi wa Kavanaugh.

rows.output: Firaministan Birtaniya May ta zargi masu sukar ta da "yin siyasa" game da Brexit.

rows.output: Firaminista Theresa May ta zargi masu sukar shirinta na barin Tarayyar Turai da "yin siyasa" da makomar Birtaniya da kuma lalata muradun kasa a wata hira da jaridar Sunday Times.
rows.reference: Firaminista Theresa May ta soki masu suka na shirye-shiryenta na barin Tarayyar Turai da “maida abin siyasa” da makomar Birtaniyya da kuma zagon ƙasa ga abin da ƙasa ke sha’awa a cikin wata tattaunawa tare da jaridar Sunday Times.

rows.output: Birtaniya ta kai ziyara a ziyarar taron jam'iyyar Conservative a Birmingham, Birtaniya, 29 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: Firaministan Birtaniyya Theresa May ta zo Taron Jam’iyyar Conservative a cikin Birmingham, Birtaniyya, a ranar 29 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.output: A wani hira da aka yi a gefen wanda ta yi a shafin farko na jaridar, tsohon ministan harkokin waje Boris Johnson ya kara kaimi ga hare-haren da ta ke yi a shirinta na Chequers na Brexit, inda ya ce shawarar da Birtaniya da Tarayyar Turai su tara haraji ga juna "abu ne mai ban mamaki."
rows.reference: A cikin wata tattaunawar a gaba da wadda aka yi da ita a kan shafin gaba na jaridar, tsohon ministanta kan harkokin ƙasashen waje Boris Johnson ya tirjewa a kan harinsa na shirin Chequers ɗin nata don Brexit, yana cewa wani ƙudurin da ke cewa ya kamata Birtaniyya da Tarayyar Turai su karɓi kuɗaɗen fito na juna ya kasance “gaba ɗaya shirme ne.”

rows.output: An kama wanda ake zargin Dyteon Simpson a cikin mutuwar Wayde Sims
rows.reference: Harbin Wayde Sims ‘Yan sanda sun kama Dyteon Simpson da ake tuhuma a kan kisan ɗan wasan LSU.

rows.output: An kama wani da ake zargi da laifin kashe Wayde Sims, wanda ya kai shekaru 20, dan wasan kwallon kwando a Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama wani da ake tuhuma a cikin mummunan harbi da ya kashe Wayde Sims, wani mai shekaru 20 kuma dan wasan ƙwallon kwando a LSU.

rows.output: Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20, an kama shi kuma an sanya shi a gidan yari bisa laifin kisan kai na biyu, a cewar sashen 'yan sanda na Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: An kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20 kuma an kai shi kurkuku a kan wata tuhumar kisa mai mataki na biyu, inji Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sandan Baton Rouge.

rows.output: Jami'an sun fitar da bidiyo na fadan da ke tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun saki bidiyo na takardamar tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.

rows.output: An dawo da gilashin daga wurin da laifin ya faru, kuma jami'an sun ce sun sami DNA na Simpson a kansu, a cewar wani rahoto na CBS WAFB.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun sami gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin inda suka kuma ce sun sami abin halittar DNA na Simpson a kansu, kamar yadda rahoton WAFB mai alaƙa da CBS ya faɗa.

rows.output: Bayan an yi wa Simpson tambayoyi, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da kashe Wayde.
rows.reference: Bayan tambayan Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amsa laifi na mummunan harbin Wayde.

rows.output: An saita albashin sa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar jaridar Advocate.
rows.reference: An sa kuɗin belinsa a dala 350,000, a cewar rahoton Advocate.

rows.output: Ofishin Likitan Gwamnatin Gabashin Baton Rouge ya fitar da rahoton bincike na farko a ranar Juma'a, inda ya bayyana cewa dalilin mutuwar shi ne karan bindiga a kai zuwa wuya.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.output: Sashen ya ba da kudin Louisiana State Police fugitive task force, dakin binciken laifukan jihar, 'yan sandan Jami'ar Kudu da kuma mazauna yankin wajen taimakawa wajen binciken da ya kai ga kama mutumin.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar ta yabi jami’an ‘yan sanda na Jihar Louisiana masu aikin kama wanda ya gudu, da ɗakin ‘yan sanda na gwajin kimiyyar aikata lafi na jihar, da ‘yan sandan Jami’ar Kudanci da mazauna yanki don taimakawa a binciken da ya kai ga kamen.

rows.output: Jami'in wasanni na Jami'ar Jihar Louisian, Joe Alleva, ya gode wa hukumomin tsaro na yankin bisa "jajircewarsu da kuma neman adalci."
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.output: Sims yana da shekaru ashirin.

rows.output: Babban gaba mai tsawon ƙafa 6-6 ya girma a Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, ya kuma buga kwallon kwando a Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana.
rows.reference: Mai tsawon tattaki 6 da 6 ya girma ne a cikin Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, shi ma ya buga wasan ƙwallon kwando ga LSU.

rows.output: Ya kai matsakaicin maki 5.6 da kuma 2.6 a kowane wasa a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Yana da matsakaicin maki 5.6 da sake dawo da ƙididdigar ci na 2.6 a wani na lokacin da shuɗe.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, mai horar da kwallon kwando ta Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana (LSU) Will Wade ya ce kungiyar ta "ta kasance cikin bakin ciki" kuma "ta cikin damuwa" da mutuwar Wayde.
rows.reference: A ranar Juma’a da safe, mai horar da ‘yan wasan ƙwallon kwandon na LSU Will Wade ya ce ƙungiyar ta sami “tashin hankali” da “girgiza” da mutuwar ta Wayde.

rows.output: "Wannan shi ne abin da kuke damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," Wade ya ce.
rows.reference: “Wannan shi ne abin mutum yake damuwa game da shi a dukkan lokaci,” inji Wade.

rows.output: Wani tsauni ya zubar da ash a birnin Mexico
rows.reference: Babban dutsi mai amon wuta ya fesa toka a kan Birnin Mexico

rows.output: Garin da ke fitowa daga tsaunukan Popocatepetl ya kai ga unguwannin kudu na babban birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kasa ta Gargaɗi ta Gargaɗi ta gargadi 'yan ƙasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su kauce wa tsaunukan bayan da ake samun karuwar ayyukan a cikin kogon kuma ya rubuta fitar da iskar gas da kura 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da girgizar kasa da girgizar kasa da dama.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda guntun gawayi ke rufe tagogin motoci a unguwannin birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana ilimin kasa sun lura da karuwar ayyukan a wani tsauni da ke da nisan mil 45 (72 km) kudu maso gabashin babban birnin kasar tun bayan wani girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar kasar Mexico a watan Satumba na shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: Tsaunin da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya kasance yana aiki tun 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Jami'an tsaro sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai na Catalan kafin ranar tunawa da kada kuri'a
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai suka yi ta kai hari kan 'yan sanda, yayin da dubban mutane suka shiga zanga-zangar da suka yi a kan gaba da bikin cika shekara guda da jihar Catalonia ta gudanar da zaben raba kawuna.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani rukuni na masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai da suka rufe fuskar su sun yi ta kai wa 'yan sanda da ke kula da tarzoma da kwai, sannan suka jefa fenti, wanda ya haifar da duwatsun duwatsu a tituna da ake yawan cunkoso da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi faɗa a baya-bayan nan a ranar da ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da sandunan su wajen sarrafa faɗa.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, kungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi ihu "Babu mantawa, babu gafara" a yayin da masu fafutukar hadin kan suka yi ihu "Rayuwa ta Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Mutanen goma sha hudu sun samu magani saboda raunukan da suka samu a lokacin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tashin hankali ya ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son yin gudu shekara guda bayan kuri'ar raba gardama da aka gudanar a ranar 1 ga watan Oktoba, wanda gwamnatin Madrid ta dauka a matsayin haramtacce, amma kuma 'yan kasar Catalan masu neman 'yanci suka yi murna da shi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa ƙuri'a sun zaɓi da yawa su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da cewa an samu ƙarancin fitowar masu jefa ƙuri'a, inda waɗanda suka yi adawa da rabuwa suka fi yin watsi da zaɓen.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: A cewar hukumomin Catalan, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka ji rauni a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da ‘yan sanda suka yi yunkurin hana zaben gudana a rumfunan zabe a fadin yankin a lokacin da ake fama da tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan samun 'yancin kai sun yi biki a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar goyon bayan 'yan sandan ƙasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An gudanar da zanga-zangar amma an tilasta mata daukar wata hanya ta daban.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, 68, wani lantarki mai aiki a zanga-zangar neman 'yancin kai tare da matarsa ​​ta ce ba ta da fata game da damar da Catalonia za ta samu 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "Shekarar da ta gabata mun rayu ta hanyar daya daga cikin lokutan da muka fi so.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar kada kuri'a amma yanzu muna makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun samu nasara mai matukar muhimmanci a zaben yankin da ya gabata a watan Disamba, jam'iyyun 'yancin kai na Catalan sun yi kokarin ci gaba da samun karfin guiwa a wannan shekarar, inda da dama daga cikin shugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su suna cikin gudun hijira da kansu ko kuma a tsare suna jiran shari'a bisa laifin da suka yi na shirya zaben raba gardama da kuma sanar da 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani ma’aikacin mota mai shekaru 42, wanda ke yin rikodin zanga-zangar da ke goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya karu ne sakamakon siyasa daga bangarorin biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana kara tsananta kuma yana kara tsananta," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin shugabannin Catalonia tara da ake tsare da su a gidan yari tun daga karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya bayyana cewa zai tsaya takarar zaben majalisar dokokin Turai a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa takarar zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta adawa da koma bayan dabi'un dimokuradiyya da kuma zalunci da gwamnatin Spain ta yi," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: Mutane da aka kama bayan mota ta yi karo da gidan
rows.reference: Londonderry: An kama masu maza bayan an doka mota a gida

rows.output: Mutane uku, masu shekaru 33, 34, da 39, an kama su bayan an yi wa wata mota hari a gidan da ke Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na yamma.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.output: Sai mai binciken ya ce an lalata kofofin da kuma ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.output: Wani kuma zai iya harba wani katon kibiya a motar a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga ya ci kwallon da ta ba wa Livingston nasara a kan Rangers da ci 1-0.
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Kwallon farko da Dolly Menga ta ci ga Livingston ta samu nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.output: An inganta Livingston ya mamaye Rangers ya sanya Steven Gerrard ya fuskanci rashin nasara na biyu a wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta zama abin da ya sa bambamci, yayin da Gary Holt's side ta kai matakin Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar ta Gerrard tana ci gaba da rashin nasara a wajen gida a gasar Premier a wannan kakar kuma za ta fuskanci kungiyar ta farko ta Hearts, wadda suke bayan ta da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers suna karbar Vienna a gasar cin kofin Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Lokacin da aka yi, suna da tsawon wasanni shida ba tare da an doke su ba a gasar, kuma koci Holt bai taba yin rashin nasara ba tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damar da za su yi da baƙi masu tsauri
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Tawagar Holt ta kamata ta kasance a gaba tun da wuri kafin su ci, tare da tsarin su na kai hari ya haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya karya shingen amma ya ja kai a fuskarsa, sannan Alan Lithgow ya iya kaiwa ga kwallo kawai bayan ya yi tafiya a cikin kwallo.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun yi farin ciki su bar Rangers su buga a gabansu, suna sanin cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasa.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma hakan shi ne yadda aka samu muhimmin kwallo.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: Rangers sun yi kuskure a cikin kwallo ta kyauta, kuma sun samu damar shiga, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don saita Menga, wanda ya dauki kwallo ya ci kwallo daga tsakiyar akwatin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan matakin, Rangers sun mamaye mallaka amma sun gano cewa tsaron gida ya yi matukar wahala, kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.

rows.reference: Ford ita ma ta ba shaida a jin bahasin game da ƙagen nata.

rows.output: Shugaban ya ce a ranar Asabar cewa "mutanen Amurka sun ga kyawun da ingancin da jaruntaka" na Kavanaugh a wannan rana.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya faɗa a rana Asabar cewa “Amurkawa sun ga fasaha da kyau da ƙarfin hali” na Kavanaugh wannan ranar.

rows.output: "Wani kuri'a na tabbatar da Alkalin Kavanaugh shine kuri'a na tabbatar da daya daga cikin mafi girman tunani na shari'a a zamaninmu, alkalin da ke da kyakkyawan tarihin aikin jama'a," ya faɗa wa taron masu goyon bayan West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.output: Shugaban kasa ya yi magana a hankali game da takarar Kavanaugh yayin da yake tattaunawa kan muhimmancin fitowar jam’iyyar Republican a zaben tsakiyar wa’adi.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.output: "Ƙarshen makonni biyar daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓen da suka fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina gudu sosai," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.output: "Abin da ya sa nake yawan yin aiki a wurare daban-daban don fafutukar daidaita tsarin zabe."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan jam'iyyar Democrat suna da niyyar "juriya da kuma hana."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.output: An yi tsammanin za a gudanar da kuri'ar farko ta hanyar da za a bi wajen amincewa da takarar Kavanaugh a majalisar dattijai ba daga baya ba a ranar Juma'a, wani jami'in shugabancin jam'iyyar Republican mai matsayi ya faɗa wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.output: An kashe dubban mutane a cikin girgizar kasa da tsunami da suka afku a kasar Indonesia, kuma ana sa ran adadin wadanda suka mutu zai karu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa daga cikinsu an kwashe su da manyan igiyoyin ruwa da suka mamaye bakin teku, bayan da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomi a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi taron jama'a da yawa a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka taso a bakin teku a lokacin faduwar rana, inda suka kwashe mutane da dama zuwa ga mutuwarsu, tare da lalata duk wani abu da ke kan hanyarsu.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An biyo bayan girgizar kasa mai karfin awo 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Yau da kullum, lokacin da aka samu barazanar tsunami, mutane suna ci gaba da yin ayyukansu a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wadanda suka mutu," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kula da bala'i ta Indonesia BNPB a wani taron manema labarai a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ƙarar tsunami ba ta zo da kanta ba, ta ja motoci, itatuwa, gidaje, ta buga komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, yana ƙara cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a cikin teku mai buɗewa a saurin kilomita 800 a cikin sa'a (kilomita 497 a cikin sa'a) kafin ta buga gabar teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun hau bishiyoyi don su tsallake igiyar ruwa da suka tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyi 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jirgin sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata gine-gine da shaguna, an murɗe gadoji, kuma an ruguje masallaci da ruwa ya kewaye.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: Rashin karfi ya ci gaba da girgiza birnin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar tantancewa da amfani da fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa makamashin da aka saki ta hanyar girgizar kasa mai girma a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankin birnin, wanda ke kusa da ƙarshen wani kogon da ya yi tsawo, na iya ƙara girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai yawa" kuma ya ce dubban gidaje, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawar wasu wadanda suka mutu a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, inda ya kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce mutanen da suka mutu da kuma lalacewar gine-gine na iya zama mafi girma a bakin tekun, kimanin kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ke kusa da cibiyar girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Hanyoyin sadarwa "sun kasance gaba daya cikin kunci ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai mutane sama da 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa da kungiyar Red Cross ta fitar, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatansu da masu aikin sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa yankunan da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan wani abu ne mai ban tausayi, amma zai iya ƙara tsananta."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'ai sun ce igiyoyin sun zo ne kafin a fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin bidiyon da ba na kwararru ba da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na gini yana iya ganin yana ihu cikin damuwa game da igiyar ruwa mai gabatowa zuwa ga mutanen da ke kan titi a kasa.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, bangon ruwa ya faɗo a bakin teku, yana ɗauke da gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: Reuters bai iya tabbatar da faifan bidiyon nan da nan ba.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Garin ya yi girma sosai, wanda ya haifar da cikas a cikin sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukumomi su tsara kokarin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: Sojojin sun fara aika jiragen kaya da taimako daga Jakarta da sauran biranen, a cewar hukumomi, amma 'yan gudun hijirar na bukatar abinci da sauran abubuwan da suka dace.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: Birnin ya bude filin jirgin sama ne kawai don ayyukan agaji kuma zai ci gaba da rufe har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya shirya ziyartar cibiyoyin gaggawa a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indonesia: Mutuwar Tsunami ta haura 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan World Vision daga Donggala suka isa Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikata ke kwana a cikin gidajen tarpaulin da aka kafa a cikin fadar ofishinsu, sun ga yanayin bala'i a kan hanyarsu, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Suna cewa sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Ko da yake kungiyoyin agaji sun fara aikin fara shirye-shiryen taimakon bala'i, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agaji na kasashen waje da suka kware sosai sun hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesiya, kuɗin, kayayyaki da ma'aikata daga ƙasashen waje za su iya fara gudana ne kawai idan wurin da ya faru na bala'i an bayyana shi a matsayin yankin bala'i na ƙasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu ba a faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne na matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun hukumar agajin gaggawa ta Indonesiya.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnati ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wani bala'i ne na kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayi ba."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: A lokacin da dare na biyu ya faɗo a Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da ambaliyar ruwa a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na waɗanda har yanzu ba a gano su ba suna riƙe da fata cewa ƙaunatattun su za su zama abubuwan al'ajabi da za su sa labaran da ba su da kyau na bala'o'i na halitta su yi haske.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an cire wani yaro karami daga cikin bututun ruwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, an ceto wata mata da aka binne a karkashin tarkacen gini na tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikin mahaifiyarta a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Gordon Subandono, babban koci na tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesiya, ya horar da wasu 'yan wasan paragliding guda biyu da suka bace domin gasar wasannin Asiya, wadda ta kare a baya a wannan watan a Indonesiya.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda suka makale a otal din Roa Roa, ciki har da Mista Mandagi, dalibansa ne.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban mutum a fagen tashi da sauka, ina da nauyin zuciya na," ya ce.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a cikin sa'o'i bayan labarin rugujewar otal din Roa Roa ya bazu a tsakanin al'ummar tashi da kuma sauka, ya aika da sakonni na WhatsApp ga 'yan wasan Palu, wadanda suka shiga gasar bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙoninsa, duk da haka, ya haifar da alamar dubawa mai launin toka ɗaya kawai, maimakon alamun shuɗi biyu.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: "Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakon ba a isar da su ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Masu satar kudi sun cire dala 26,750 a lokacin da ake cika na'urar ATM a Newport a kan Levee.

rows.output: An yi sata a ranar Juma'a da safe, an sace dala 26,750 daga ma'aikacin Brink da ke cike da ATM a Newport a kan Levee, a cewar wata sanarwa da hukumar 'yan sandan Newport ta fitar.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: Direban motar ya kasance yana zubar da wani ATM a cikin wurin nishadi da kuma shirya isar da karin kudi, an bayyana a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum ya yi gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudi da aka yi niyyar isarwa.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun gano mutane da dama suna guduwa daga wurin, a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su bayyana adadin wadanda suka shiga lamarin ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.output: Wanda ke da bayanai game da asalin su ya tuntubi ‘yan sandan Newport a 859-292-3680.

rows.output: Yamma, 41, an san shi da Ye tsawon lokaci kuma ya yi amfani da wannan sunan a matsayin taken kundinsa na takwas, wanda aka fitar a watan Yuni.

rows.output: Canjin ya zo ne kafin bayyanarsa a daren Asabar, inda ake sa ran zai kaddamar da sabon kundin sa Yandhi.

rows.output: Ya maye gurbin mawakiya Ariana Grande a shirin wanda ya soke saboda "dalilan motsin rai," kamar yadda mai kirkirar shirin ya ce.

rows.output: Mexico ta yi alkawarin ba za ta yi amfani da sojoji a kan fararen hula ba.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Mexico mai jiran gado Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taba amfani da karfin soji a kan fararen hula ba yayin da kasar ke gabatowar cika shekaru 50 da wani mummunan martani da sojoji suka yi wa dalibai.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ranar Asabar a filin Tlatelolco da ba zai taba amfani da sojoji wajen murkushe mutanen Mexico ba.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: Sojoji sun harba wani zanga-zangar lumana a fadar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe mutane kusan 300 a lokacin da motsin juyin juya hali na dalibai na fara yaduwa a duk faɗin Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin tallafawa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar ba da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda suke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'i na jama'a kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da rashin damar ilimi na jawo matasa zuwa kungiyoyin masu laifi.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Amurka ya kamata ta ninka kudaden binciken A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da Sin ke kara shiga cikin basirar wucin gadi, Amurka ya kamata ta ninka kudaden da take kashewa wajen bincike a fannin, in ji masanin kudi kuma mai aikin AI, Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: Bayanin ya zo ne bayan sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi sanarwar AI, duk da cewa Amurka gabaɗaya ba ta da wata dabarar AI ta hukuma.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, Sin ta gabatar da shirinta na shekarar da ta gabata: tana da niyyar zama ta 1 a cikin ƙirƙirar AI kafin 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin binciken AI da ninki biyu zai zama kyakkyawan farawa, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa duk sauran ƙasashe suna da nisa sosai a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman gagarumin ci gaba a fannin AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Kara kudade da ninki biyu na iya kara yawan damar cewa nasarar AI ta gaba ta kasance a Amurka, Lee ya faɗa wa CNBC a wata hira da aka yi a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: Lee, wanda littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" ya fito a wannan watan da Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga, shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures ne, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya kasance shugaban gudanarwa a Microsoft Research da kuma shugaban rassa na Google a kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasar fasaha ta gwamnatin Amurka a baya kamar kalubalen binciken sojojin sama na Robotics Challenge kuma ta tambayi lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, don taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana a Amurka galibi suna aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ce ke daukar shugabannin ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google, da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun dauki fitattun malamai daga jami'o'i don su yi aiki kan AI a cikin shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canjen manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarinta na inganta fasahar AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katin kore ya kamata a ba wa PhD a fannin AI a kai a kai.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Hukumar Jiha ta kasar Sin ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar wucin gadi ta na gaba a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyya na Duniya na kasar Sin na samar da kudade ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi irin na yadda Asusun Kimiyya na Duniya da sauran kungiyoyin gwamnati ke ba masu bincike a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi a kasar Sin ya yi ƙasa da na Amurka, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali ta Artificial, wadda aka yi niyyar haɗa abokan hulɗa daga masana'antu da ilimi, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓe na Hankali na Artificial.

rows.output: Macedonians sun kada kuri'a a kan ko za su canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: Mutanen Makidoniya sun yi zabe a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewacin Makidoniya," wanda zai warware rikicin da ya dade tsakanin kasashen biyu wanda ya hana shiga Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardin da ake kira Masedoniya, ta ce sunan makwabtanta na arewa yana nuna ikirarin yankinta, kuma ta hana shiga NATO da Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatocin biyu sun cimma yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da sauyin suna jayayya cewa canjin zai lalata asalin ƙabilancin ƙabilun Slavic mafi yawa a Masedoniya.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban ƙasar Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai kada kuri'a ba a zaben, kuma yakin neman zaben ya haifar da shakku kan ko za a cimma mafi ƙarancin kashi 50 cikin 100 da ake bukata don zaben ya zama ingantacce.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar da aka yi a kai a kai ta karanta: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canjin suna, ciki har da Firaministan Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa hakan farashi ne da ya kamata a bi wajen neman shiga kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri'a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya ta yadda za su iya rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga kowa.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a wajabta ba, amma da yawa daga cikin 'yan majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon zaben, don haka ya zama mai mahimmanci.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake suna zai buƙaci kashi biyu bisa uku na rinjaye a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zaben jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoton wani abu na rashin daidaito ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu kada kuri'a ta kai kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zaben majalisar dokokin 2016 lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu rajistar sun kada kuri'arsu.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu yana Turai," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere ụjọ n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro na aha ha kwesịrị ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko omeiwu Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ dị n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha ụlọ ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe ọkwa ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpata ịkwa emo.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu ndị ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda na Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara daft na pwp pụtara ịkpa.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ dum "adịghị enwe obi ụtọ" ma tụọ aro ụzọ ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-ege ntị" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere ịwụ elu okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka ụda nke mkpụrụedemede u na asụsụ Bekee Yorkshire.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Kọmitii Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-ede ugbu a iwu ijiwebata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ banyere ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Ụlọ Nzukọ na-akpọ ga-adabere n'ikpeazụ n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Gọọmentị Wales 2017 nyere ndị ọchịchị Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ha.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Kọmishọna ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke ịkpọtụrụ ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ dị ka Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
